identity.name: The Architect's Ledger
identity.tone: Precision, Financial Trust, Modern Agency Clarity
identity.aesthetics: Swiss Minimalist meets Modern SaaS. High contrast, clean whitespace, structural typography.

rules: Headings must use Manrope with tight tracking.
Financial data (prices, margins) must use JetBrains Mono.
Labels and Overlines must be Uppercase, Tiny, and Tracking-Widest.
Never center text unless it's a specific empty state or hero banner.

primary.description: Deep Slate 900 for main actions and heavy hierarchy.

brand.description: Indigo for active states, focus rings, and brand identity.

success.description: Emerald for profit, positive margin, and completion.

warning.description: Amber for low margin, alerts, and pending states.

destructive.description: Red for negative profit, deletion, and errors.

layout.spacing_scale: Tailwind Scale (p-4 = 1rem). Use p-6 or p-8 for cards to create breathing room.

dashboard_3_panel.left_panel: hidden lg:flex flex-col border-r border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 p-6 overflow-y-auto
dashboard_3_panel.right_panel: hidden lg:flex flex-col border-l border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-[-4px_0_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] overflow-y-auto

cards.base: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-[0_2px_4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] transition-all duration-200

buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900 shadow-sm

inputs.base: h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-white file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-slate-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500/20 focus-visible:border-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

tables.header: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider py-3 px-4

assets.logo_placeholder: Use a simple geometric shape (e.g., a square with a missing corner) + 'OPE' text in Manrope Bold.

login_bg.usage: Full screen background for Login/Signup with overlay opacity-50

hero_abstract.alt: White modern architecture against a blue sky
hero_abstract.usage: Hero section background or Card accent

empty_state_office.usage: Background for empty state containers with high blur

rules: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
Color contrast must meet WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for normal text).
Focus states must be clearly visible (ring-2).
Do not use color alone to convey meaning (add icons/labels).

critical_rules: Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Manrope' via Google Fonts.
Implement the 3-panel layout using the grid configuration provided.
Ensure all financial numbers use 'JetBrains Mono'.
Customize Shadcn components to match the 'cards.base' and 'buttons.primary' styles defined above.

universal_guidelines.design_philosophy: Precision is luxury. Avoid gradients, use solid colors and subtle borders. Space is expensive, use it generously.
universal_guidelines.component_reuse: Check src/components/ui before building new. Customize existing Shadcn components.
universal_guidelines.export_style: Named exports for components, Default exports for pages.
